model.name: diagram.tapToAdd
model.description: R32.11-MOBILE: the TOUCH/iOS complement to the desktop drag add-view (R32.11 diagram.addView). RbDiagramDetail.onSelectionChanged listens for the document 'selection-changed' event: a SINGLE tap on a class chip (one 'modelelement:' ref) with the diagram open -> addView fires (no coords, auto-grid) -> a UML box APPEARS (POST 200). Guards: multi-select + non-modelelement refs add NO box. Fixes the Tron @390 iPhone gap (HTML5 DnD dragstart/drop does NOT fire on touch). Sibling UC of R32.11 diagram.addView (cdd29583) on the same Class RbDiagramDetail; keeps desktop DnD. Distinct Method onSelectionChanged (NOT re-crediting addView 70be1605).
